title: global time range applies immediately with Auto Run on and the picker has no Apply button
verifies: the dashboard picker renders no Apply button and a relative pick applies at once (panel re-queries once, URL gains period=6d, Refresh not warning)

title: with Auto Run off a relative pick defers to a yellow Refresh which commits it
verifies: with Auto Run off a pick is deferred (no re-query, URL unchanged, yellow Refresh with 'Refresh to apply the time range' tooltip) until Refresh is clicked

title: turning Auto Run on auto-applies a waiting time range
verifies: toggling Auto Run back on applies a deferred pick without an explicit Refresh click

title: panel-level picker applies in view mode with Auto Run on and defers with Auto Run off
verifies: the per-panel picker uses the same gate: applies at once (URL gains pt-period) with Auto Run on, defers (ghost-warning refresh) with Auto Run off

title: the full-screen view panel applies with the same time gate
verifies: the full-screen view panel applies at once with Auto Run on and defers (warning refresh) with Auto Run off

title: fresh-on-open re-queries relative panels exactly once
verifies: a fresh visit with Auto Run on and a relative range re-queries each relative panel exactly once and no more

title: Auto Run unavailable degrades to deferred apply
verifies: with auto_query_enabled=false the Auto Run toggle is hidden and a time pick defers to manual Refresh
